claims.text: SciTail is a textual entailment dataset created from natural sentences that exist independently rather than sentences authored specifically for an entailment task.
Existing state-of-the-art textual entailment systems achieve mediocre performance on SciTail relative to a simple majority class baseline.
A neural model that exploits linguistic structure improves accuracy on SciTail by 5%.

evidence.description: State-of-the-art textual entailment systems achieve mediocre performance on SciTail, especially in comparison to a simple majority class baseline.
Demonstration that accuracy on SciTail improves by 5% using a new neural model exploiting linguistic structure.

methodologies.name: SciTail Dataset Construction
methodologies.description: Hypotheses are derived from science questions and answer candidates, while premises are retrieved from web sentences.
conditions: multiple-choice science question-answering converted to entailment

methodologies.name: Linguistically Structured Neural Model
methodologies.description: A neural entailment model designed to exploit linguistic structure in premise-hypothesis pairs.

limitations.text: Premise and hypothesis pairs exhibit high lexical similarity for both entailed and non-entailed instances, making the dataset particularly challenging.
